instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: Stage 2 synthesis: A severely malnourished post-operative client has had PN started after about five weeks of negligible intake. Within 30 hours, phosphorus has fallen from 2.8 to 1.8 to 1.3 mg/dL, potassium from 3.5 to 3.1 to 2.9 mEq/L, and magnesium from 1.8 to 1.4 to 1.3 mg/dL. The client is lethargic with proximal weakness, shallow respirations, palpitations, frequent PVCs, prolonged QT interval, and glucose 226 mg/dL. The PICC site has erythema, tenderness, and small purulent drainage. Complete the bow-tie diagram.
